name: Scene: Garrick's Goods, Valemere
description: A new gameplay scene to place the concept-art components on: the merchant Garrick across his counter (the plate is the concept render '14 Merchant / no menus' with its baked caption cropped off), Garrick's line as the narration, the four heroes in the party strip, and a phone with a few choices. Place components with the scene verbs (development/playground-scripts/garrick-shop-tour.txt).

caption.speaker: Garrick the Trader
caption.text: Ah, back again? New supplies, a sturdier blade, or perhaps something a little more... unique?

narration: Lantern light catches the swords on the wall. Garrick leans on the counter, smiling like a man who already knows what you can afford.
